title: Weibull reliability: how long will the machine last?
desc: Drag β, η, the hours run and the look-ahead window to see the failure probability, the failure rate and the chance of failing in the next H hours; play to watch one machine serviced on schedule and failing now and then.

title: Choosing the service interval
desc: The long-run cost curve of age-based maintenance: drag the interval to find its minimum, then race two identical machines (one serviced every T hours, one run to failure) over 20 000 hours with the same random numbers.
